Subject: The authentic combined Gunbuster, classic 1988 OVA. Huge broad black and charcoal humanoid super robot with orange-yellow vent panels, white upper-arm details, orange lower legs, iconic head with two long orange side horns and small green forehead sensor, massively thick forearms, triangular angular chest and heavy feet. Full combined machine, not Buster Machine 1 or 2 separately. Arms folded in its signature confident stance, both feet on floor, no pilots.
Catalogue label for metadata only, do not render text: #128 slot 1 Gunbuster.
